image_description: A side-profile view of a large, dark brown bison grazing in a grassy field. The animal is facing left with its head lowered towards the ground. It exhibits a massive shoulder hump covered in shaggy fur, while the hindquarters appear smoother and less furred. The legs are sturdy, though the hooves are partially obscured by tall grass. A short tail with a tuft is visible at the rear.
